ष: ष 1. ष, the thirty-first consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet and second of the three sibilants; it belongs to the cerebral class, and in sound corresponds to sh in the English word shun. (Many roots which begin with the dental स् are written in native gram-mars and in the Dhātu-pāṭha with ष्, to show that the dental स् is liable to be cerebralized after certain prepositions.) —ष-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ष. —ष-त्व, अम्, n. the state of the letter ष, the cerebral sibilant, the substitution of ष् for स्। —षत्व-णत्व, अम्, n. the substitution of ष् for स् and of ण् for न् in grammatical derivatives.

ष 2. ष, अस्, आ, अम्, best, excellent; wise, learned; (अस्), m. loss, destruction; loss of know-ledge; end, term; rest, remainder; eternal happi-ness, final emancipation, (in some of the preceding senses said to be fr. rt. सो); heaven, paradise; sleep; a learned man, teacher; a nipple; (according to Śabda-k.) = कच; = मानव; = सर्व; = गर्भ-विमोचन [cf. षू]; (अम्), n. the embryo; patience, endurance (according to some).
3. ष at the end of a comp. = षष् (e. g. पञ्च-ष, q. v.).

(according to Śabda-k.) a kind of measure (= पल-परिमाण). —षोडशि-ग्रह, अस्, m. a libation made at the Ṣoḍaśin ceremony. —षोडशिन्, ई, m. one of the modifications of the Agni-ṣṭoma or Soma ceremony, (others being called Ukthya, Ati-rātra, Vāja-peya, &c.); a particular kind of Soma vessel. —षोडशि-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having the above ceremony. —षोडशि-शस्त्र, अम्, n. a hymn or liturgical formula recited during the above ceremony. —षोडशोपचार (°श-उप्°), अस्, m. 16 ways of doing homage, (thus enumerated, आसन, स्वागत, पाद्य, अर्घ, आचमनीय, म-धुपर्क, आचमन, स्नान, वसन, आभरण, सुगन्धि, सुमनस्, धूप, दीप, नैवेद्य, वन्दन, q. q. v. v.) —षो-ऌअशन्, Ved. = षो-ड-शन्. —षोऌअशाक्षर, Ved. = षोडशाक्षर।
षट्क: षट्क, अस्, आ, अम्, having six, sixfold, six; (अम्), n. an aggregate of six.
षष्ट: षष्ट, अस्, ई, अम्, 60th, (but only in comps. after another numeral, e. g. एक-षष्ट, one and sixtieth or sixty-first; cf. द्वि-ष्°, द्वा-ष्°, त्रि-ष्°, &c.)
षष्टि: षष्टि, इस्, f., 60. —षष्टि-तम, अस्, ई, अम्, 60th, (this is the only form of this ordinal allowed except in comps. after another numeral, cf. षष्ट above.) —षष्टि-धा, ind. in 60 ways. —षष्टि-पथ, 60 paths, (thought by some to apply to the first 60 Adhyāyas of the Śatapatha-Brāhmaṇa.) —षष्टि-भाग, अस्, m. epithet of Śiva. —षष्टि-मत्त, अस्, m. an elephant who has reached the age of 60 years (or is in rut at that period; this is supposed to end the first half of his life, cf. षष्टि-हायन). —षष्टि-योजनी, f. a journey or extent of 60 Yojanas. —षष्टि-लता, f. a kind of plant (= भ्रमर-मारी). —षष्टि-वर्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, having 60 years, 60 years old. —षष्टि-संवत्-सर, अस्, m. a period of 60 years or the 60th year (from birth &c.). —षष्टि-हायन, अस्, m. a period of 60 years or the 60th year (from birth &c.); (अस्, आ, अम्), 60 years old; (अस्), m. an elephant; a kind of rice, (see षष्टिक।) —षष्ट्य्-अधिक, अस्, आ, अम्, exceeded by 60. —षष्ट्य्-अधिक-शत, अम्, n., 160.
षष्टिक: षष्टिक, अस्, आ, अम्, bought with 60; (अस्, आ), m. f. a kind of rice of quick growth (ripening in about 60 days).
षष्टिक्य: षष्टिक्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (a field &c.) fit for sowing with the above rice; (अम्), n. a field sown with this rice.
षष्ठ: षष्ठ, अस्, ई, अम्, sixth, the sixth; (अस्), m., scil. अक्षर, the sixth letter, i. e. the vowel ई (in the Ṛg-veda Prātiśākhya); (ई), f. the sixth day of a lunar fortnight; a particular Tithi when rites are per-formed to the sixth lunar digit; the sixth or genitive case; an epithet of Durgā in the form Kātyāyanī or of one of the 16 divine mothers; [cf. Zend kṣtva for kṣvasta; Gr. ἕκτος; Lat. sextus; Goth. sach-sta(n); Angl. Sax. sixta; Lith. szeszta-s; Slav. ses-ty; Hib. seiseadh.] —षष्ठादि (°ठ-आदि), इस्, इस्, इ, beginning with the sixth letter, i. e. with the vowel ई (in Vedic grammar). —षष्ठान्न (°ठ-अन्°), अम्, n. the sixth meal. —षष्ठान्न-काल or षष्ठान्न-कालक, अम्, n. taking food at the sixth period, i. e. once in three days as an act of penance, (also written षष्ठालु-कालक।) —षष्ठान्नकाल-ता, f. eating only at the time of the sixth meal, i. e. once in three days or on the evening of every third day. —षष्ठी-जाय, अस्, m. one who has a sixth wife. —षष्ठी-तत्पु-रुष or षष्ठी-समास, अस्, m. a Tat-puruṣa compound of which the first member is a genitive case. —षष्ठी-पूजन, अम्, n. or षष्ठी-पूजा, f. worship of the goddess Ṣaṣṭhī (especially per-formed by a woman on the sixth day after delivery). —षष्ठी-व्रत, अम्, n. a religious observance kept on the sixth day of one of the halves of a month. —षष्ठ्य्-आदि-कल्प-बोधन, अम्, n. a festival in honour of Durgā on the sixth day of the month Āśvina (when she is supposed to be awakened).
षष्ठक: षष्ठक, अस्, आ or ई (?) or इका, अम्, sixth, the sixth; (इका), f., N. of one of the divine mothers, (see षष्ठी।)
षष्ठिन्: षष्ठिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a sixth, having or being the sixth (year &c.).
षोढा: षो-ढा, ind. in six ways, sixfold. —षोढा-न्यास, अस्, m. 16 ways of disposing magical texts on the body (as practised by the Tāntrikas).
षहसान: षहसान, अस्, आ, अम्, patient; (अस्), m. a pea-cock; sacrifice (= सहसान, q. v.; according to Śabda-k. written षहसानु).
षाच्: षाच् षाच् for साच्, q. v.
षाट्: षाट् षाट्, ind. a vocative particle or inter-jection of calling (according to some).
षाट्कौशिक: षाट्कौशिक षाट्कौशिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. षट्-कोश), enveloped in six sheathes.
षाट्पौरुषिक: षाट्पौरुषिक षाट्पौरुषिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. षष् + पुरुष), relating or belonging to six generations.
षाडव: षाडव षाडव, अम्, n. (fr. षष्), senti-ment, passion; singing, music; a particular kind of Rāga; [cf. षड्-ज।]
षाङ्गुण्य: षाङ्गुण्य षाड्गुण्य, अम्, n. (fr. षड्-गुण), the aggregate of six qualities; six properties; six measures or acts of royal policy, (see षड्-गुण); six articles (of any kind); multiplication of anything by six. —षाड्गुण्य-प्रयोग, अस्, m. the applica-tion or practice of the above six measures. —षाड्-गुण्य-संयुत, अस्, आ, अम्, connected or accom-panied with the six qualities or measures, &c.
षाण्मातुर: षाण्मातुर षाण्मातुर, अस्, m. (fr. षष् + मा-तृ), ‘having six mothers,’ epithet of Kārttikeya, q. v.
षाण्मासिक: षाण्मासिक षाण्मासिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. षण्-मास), six-monthly, half-yearly, six months old, of six months standing, lasting six months.
षात्वणत्विक: षात्वणत्विक षात्वणत्विक, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr. षत्व-णत्व), relating to the substitution of ष् for स् and ण् for न्।
षामिल: षामिल षामिल, N. of a place.
षाष्ठ: षाष्ठ षाष्ठ, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr. षष्ठ), sixth, the sixth.
षाष्ठिक: षाष्ठिक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the sixth, taught or explained in the sixth book of Pāṇini, (similarly आष्टमिक, taught in the eighth book.)
षिट्: षिट् षिट् = rt. सिट्, q. v.
षिड्ग: षिड्ग, अस्, m. a profligate man, libertine, lecher; an inconstant lover, gallant.
षु: 2. षु, उस्, m. child-bearing, parturition, delivery.
षू: षू, ऊस्, f. (= 4. सू, q. v.), child-bearing, delivery, birth.
षुराजिम: षुराजिम षुराजिम, N. of a place; [cf. षराजिम।]
ष्ट्युम: ष्ट्युम ष्ट्युम, अस्, m. (according to some) the moon; light.
ष्ठिव्: ष्ठिव् ष्ठिव् or ष्ठीव्, cl. 1. 4. ष्ठीवन: ष्ठीवन, अम्, n. the act of spitting, ejecting saliva; saliva, spittle.
ष्ठीव्यमान: ष्ठीव्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being spit.
ष्ठेवितव्य: ष्ठेवितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spit or spit out.
ष्ठेवितृ: ष्ठेवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, one who spits, spitting.
ष्ठेवित्वा: ष्ठेवित्वा, ind. having spit, having ejected saliva.
ष्ठेविन्: ष्ठेविन्, ई, इनी, इ, spitting, ejecting from the mouth.
ष्ठेव्य: ष्ठेव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spit, &c.
ष्ठ्यूत: ष्ठ्यूत, अस्, आ, अम्, spit, ejected (as saliva).
ष्ठ्यूति: ष्ठ्यूति, इस्, f. spitting, sputtering out.
ष्ठ्यूत्वा: ष्ठ्यूत्वा, ind. having spit or spit out.
ष्वस्क्: ष्वस्क् ष्वस्क् or ष्वष्क् (also written ष्वक्क्, षुक्क्, स्वस्क्), cl. 1. A. ष्व-स्कते, ष्वष्कते, &c., to go, (in Naigh. II. 14. ष्वःकति, or according to another reading ष्वष्-कति, and षष्कति are enumerated among the गति-कर्माणः।)
